notes: Fresh checks for GEMAS (EUROPE_GEMAS) loaded 14 Nov 2026. Not part of the gate.

questions.q: What soil geochemistry do you have for Ukraine and Poland?
questions.judge: Says the data for Ukraine and Poland are GEMAS agricultural and grazing-land soil samples (about 158 and 129 agricultural sites respectively, plus grazing-land samples), at one site per 2,500 km2, sampled 2008-2009, analysed by aqua regia, XRF and MMI. Notes this is low-density, continental-scale data and that there is no national survey for these countries in the database. Credits GEMAS / EuroGeoSurveys (CC BY 4.0). Does not invent other datasets.

questions.q: Which European countries have the highest lithium in agricultural soils?
questions.judge: Uses EUROPE_GEMAS agricultural (Ap) soil aqua regia Li grouped by country, gives medians or high values with mg/kg (ppm) units and names the top countries. Says aqua regia is a partial extraction and that GEMAS is low density (1 site per 2,500 km2), so this shows broad patterns, not deposits. Credits GEMAS. Does not mix in other surveys without saying so.
